findings.suggested_change: The scope of Services is strictly limited to the tasks explicitly detailed herein, and any additional services or changes requested by the Client shall be subject to a mutually agreed written change order detailing additional fees.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello. Thank you for sending over the agreement. I would like to propose a few adjustments before signing. - Regarding the relevant clause, the description of services is open-ended and lacks a change-order mechanism, so we propose updating it to state that the scope of Services is strictly limited to the tasks explicitly detailed herein, and any additional services or changes requested shall be subject to a mutually agreed written change order detailing additional fees. - Regarding the relevant clause, ownership of the work product transfers immediately upon creation rather than upon receipt of full payment, so we propose updating it to state that upon full payment of all applicable fees due for the deliverables, ownership of the final deliverables shall transfer to the Client. Thank you, and I look forward to finalizing this.
